mechanism_summaries.FXFV2-A5-P1: Same-day extreme residual dislocation convergence: at the 12:00Z-bar completion, day-to-date pair returns are demeaned against the equal-weighted 7-pair USD index (m cancels exactly in the equal-notional extreme-vs-extreme spread); gate standardized range >= 3.0; long argmin / short argmax (2 legs, 6 bps RT base); half-reversion exit (0.5 x entry dislocation) or forced flat at the 16:00 New York bar open; placebo control de-links ranking via a date-seeded hash; trailing-4h-window neighbour. Literature: Lustig-Roussanov-Verdelhan 2011 JF; Osler 2003 JF.
mechanism_summaries.FXFV2-A5-P2: Prior-session outlier basket reversal: at the 07:00Z-bar completion, the previous trading session's demeaned, vol-standardized returns are ranked; gate standardized range >= 2.0; long bottom-2 vs short top-2 baskets (4 legs, 12 bps RT base, counted honestly); hold-to-flat exit at the 16:00 New York bar open; stale T-2-ranking causal control; final-8-bars-of-prior-session neighbour. Literature: Lehmann 1990 QJE; Nagel 2012 RFS (equity results used as mechanism templates, stated as such).

differentiation_note: P1 is an intraday overshoot-and-correction of a same-day dislocation (conditional reversion exit, 2 legs); P2 is an inter-day liquidity-provision reversal of yesterday's outliers (hold-to-flat, 4-leg baskets). Different drivers, windows, clocks, exit rules, leg counts and literature; both symmetric over the full 7-pair universe with explicit USD-factor-neutral algebra.

forbidden_list: research/proposals/** (any cycle; directory created without listing or reading)

design_discipline.frozen_constants_per_arm: one spec per arm; every threshold, window, clock and weight is a single frozen constant (no menus, ranges or grids)
design_discipline.frequency_contract_obeyed_by_constructio: <= 1 entry/pair/UTC-day and <= 3 RT/pair/week via frozen substitution backstops; forced flat at the 16:00 America/New_York bar open on the entry UTC day
design_discipline.cost_counted_per_leg: P1: 4 side-leg charges/RT (6.0/9.0/12.0 bps at tiers); P2: 8 side-leg charges/RT (12.0/18.0/24.0 bps); break-even diagnostic C* required > 1.5 base and > 3.0 tier-2.0
